shorts.title: Slotkin: "I Want That Deterrence Message Sent" - Now Comes An Ethics Complaint #Shorts
shorts.narration: [serious] Folks, a sitting U.S. senator said out loud that she wants young people to think twice about working for the Trump administration. That's Elissa Slotkin of Michigan, and her words were: "I want that deterrence message sent." [beat] [deadpan] Deterrence. For a government job. Friends, that's not a recruiting pitch, that's a hostage note with a pension. Now a University of Chicago student has filed an ethics complaint, and Slotkin calls the whole thing "manufactured outrage." [amused] Well, ma'am, the outrage wasn't manufactured. It was quoted. [beat] Proverbs 26:27: "Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein." [sarcastic] Looks like somebody brought a shovel to a Q and A. So Democrats, if a Republican said this about your side's jobs, would you call it oversight? Tell me in the comments. Subscribe, Henry roasts the news every day.

claims.text: Sen. Elissa Slotkin said at an October 13 University of Chicago event: "I want that deterrence message sent."
A University of Chicago student, Michael Bicksel, filed an ethics complaint against Slotkin with the Senate Select Committee on Ethics over the remarks
Slotkin called the controversy "manufactured outrage" when pressed on CNN
Slotkin said she wants young people to say of working for the Trump administration: "Lord, that might be buying myself a ton of problems that I don't want"

shorts.title: DHS Says It Is "Laser Focused" On Noncitizen Voters - A Judge Just Hit Pause #Shorts
shorts.narration: [serious] Folks, nine states, days before the midterms, and a federal judge just told Homeland Security to stand down. U.S. District Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín, a Biden appointee, ordered DHS to halt certain investigations into suspected illegal voting, citing voter intimidation. She did not rule that investigating noncitizen voting is unlawful. She said DHS's methods likely violate the law. A DHS spokesperson says: [serious] "DHS is laser focused on identifying, prosecuting, and removing aliens who vote and dilute the votes of U.S. citizens." [beat] [deadpan] Laser focused. Until Friday, anyway. [amused] The order is delayed until Friday so the administration can appeal, and it expires on Election Day. Ecclesiastes 1:9: "there is no new thing under the sun." [beat] [sarcastic] Including a court ruling that lands right before an election. So Democrats, do you want illegal voting investigated at all? Tell me in the comments. Subscribe, Henry roasts the news every day.

claims.text: U.S. District Judge Araceli Martínez-Olguín, a Biden nominee, ruled that DHS must halt certain investigations into suspected illegal voting, citing concerns about voter intimidation
The order covers field investigations involving U.S. citizens in California, Connecticut, Georgia, Missouri, Nevada, New York, Pennsylvania, Washington and Wisconsin
The judge did not rule that investigating noncitizen voting is unlawful; she found DHS's methods likely violate the law
Enforcement was delayed until Friday to allow an appeal, and the restrictions expire on Election Day unless the court orders otherwise
A DHS spokesperson told Fox News Digital: "DHS is laser focused on identifying, prosecuting, and removing aliens who vote and dilute the votes of U.S. citizens."

shorts.title: Manchin Hits The Trail For A Republican: "She Is Not A Trump Senator" #Shorts

shorts.title: Jordan And Issa Ask Judiciary To Review A Judge Over Trump Lawyer Sanctions #Shorts
shorts.narration: [serious] Folks, two House Republicans just asked the federal judiciary to look into a judge. Jim Jordan and Darrell Issa wrote that they see "evidence that Judge Williams abused her judicial authority." That's Judge Kathleen Williams in Florida, an Obama appointee, who sanctioned two of Trump's lawyers. [beat] And Issa's statement has a phrase for judges like that: [deadpan] "Trump Resistance in Robes." [amused] Sounds like a Netflix series nobody asked for, with a very long trailer. The backdrop: Trump sued the IRS for ten billion dollars over a leaked tax return, dropped the suit, and the administration announced a one point seven seven six billion dollar anti-weaponization fund. [beat] Proverbs 24:23: "It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment." [sarcastic] Good rule. Applies to everybody in the building. So Democrats, if the judge was impartial, why fear a review? Tell me in the comments. Subscribe, Henry roasts the news every day.

claims.text: House Judiciary Chairman Jim Jordan and Rep. Darrell Issa asked the Judicial Conference of the United States to review U.S. District Judge Kathleen Williams (S.D. Fla.), an Obama appointee, over her sanctions of Trump's lawyers
Jordan and Issa wrote there is "evidence that Judge Williams abused her judicial authority and violated fundamental tenets of judicial impartiality"
Issa told Fox News Digital: "The rogue federal judges who make up the Trump Resistance in Robes continue to disappoint but never surprise."
In a July 13 order Williams sanctioned two Trump lawyers, referring one to the Florida Bar and barring the other from practicing before her for at least a year
Trump and the Trump Organization sued the IRS for $10 billion in early 2026 over a tax return leak, dismissed it in May, and the administration then announced a $1.776 billion anti-weaponization fund

shorts.title: Ilhan Omar Asked If Her Ex-Husband Is Family: "Not To My Knowledge" #Shorts
shorts.narration: [serious] Folks, Congresswoman Ilhan Omar gave her first interview since federal agents searched her D.C. home on October twelfth. MS NOW's Chris Hayes asked whether she has any family relation to her former husband, Ahmed Nur Said Elmi. Her answer: [deadpan] "Not to my knowledge." [beat] [amused] Not to my knowledge. Friends, that's the most carefully built sentence in Washington since the last congressional hearing. Omar denies the marriage was immigration fraud and calls the investigation politically motivated. The Justice Department hasn't publicly detailed the allegations. Everything here is allegation and denial. [beat] Luke 8:17: "For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest." [sarcastic] Notice that says nothing about a timeline. So Democrats, if this were a Republican, would you wait for the facts? Tell me in the comments. Subscribe, Henry roasts the news every day.
